Name: Haley by Amahra Dracul
Author: AmahraDracul
Description:
[font=Arial] ﻿So the mod was first created around 2017 (I guess), the art is very old. When I decided to revisit this mod I was not in the mood to redraw ﻿everything ﻿(pixel art is amazing, but very time consuming), what I'm really trying to say here is: this is a lazy job! So I know that some things are not ﻿perfect or not ﻿good at all, but hopefully this will not stop you from enjoying the new Haley.
﻿I've corrected a few little things and made new clothes basically.
Her blue hair color is a bit lighter than the photos, I'll change the pictures eventually.

    ====================================================================================================================﻿

﻿﻿ ﻿[size=5]What will change?
[/size]
[/font][font=Arial][list=1]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Haley portraits and character sprites will get some changes, her hair color now has a blue option to match her sister;[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]There are configurable options to choose her clothes between seasonal or non seasonal;[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]There are two options for the summer and winter clothing;[/size][/font]
[*][size=3]Haley will change her clothing on the Flower Dance, Luau and Spirit's Eve.[/size]
[/list]
    ====================================================================================================================﻿

[size=5] ﻿How to Install:[/size]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Arial]Make sure to have the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher;[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Unzip the folder with 7zip, WinRAR or a similar software;[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Put the unzipped folder named "[CP] Haley by Amahra Dracul" in the Mods folder of your game files.[/font]
[/list][font=Arial]
[/font][font=Arial][size=3]   [/size][size=2] ============================================================================================================================﻿[/size]
[size=3]
I tested the mod, but if you find any error, let me know, I'll fix as soon as I can.﻿
﻿Suggestions and feedback are always welcome :)[/size]
[/font]
